summary: I Part act. rakíwewayne at MAC Ishaq old houses/94 expresses continuing economic dependence with ʕal-resources. Its stative shape is distinct from the finite rakiwo at 28/82 and drəkwo at MAC Ishaq Material culture/72.

III Infectum-wa gmarkawwo concerns habitual winter installation. Active III objects include luggage, eyes, loom material, knife parts and knucklebones; reciprocal ʕal ḥḏoḏe and side-by-side barra d ḥḏoḏe specify arrangement rather than separate lexical verbs.

Detransitive Part. Pass. markawto/markuwo presents an established configuration: sky resting on a mountain and a stowed plough. An explicit numbered Detransitive gloss is supplied for a box that already existed.

Do not conflate fitting/placement rkw with riding/mounting roots just because the English translation gives literal rides. The gun context also does not select load, cock or assemble over general readiness/positioning.

The untranslated Ilyas Infectum mental-maturity example is filed under garment-fitting sense 2, while the comparable Preterit mental example is under sense 1. This may be an inherited filing issue, but no new source translation is invented.
Authored prose introduces b-preserving learned composition forms beside native rkw placement forms. Their shared stem/root affiliation is provisional; no external etymology was consulted.

l-marked lexical agents accompany Preterit agent suffixes (Jan 3.4/45,52); markawlan in Jan 2.12/2877 is active 1pl, although its supplied English passivises it. Additional -le in markawlele remains unsegmented.
Plural rakiwe ne confirms a stative predicate, while feminine rakiwo also serves as Preterit Intransitive. Masculine modifiers must not automatically be read as feminine finite predicates.
Round-1 structural corrections to the Kfarze variant and III Detransitive example are retained in the human baseline; no duplicate corrections are proposed.
At the MAC murder narrative /12, what physical operation does markawle u+silāḥ denote? No load/cock technical sense is published without confirmation.
Confirm the inherited Infectum-wa filing of rəkwiwa at JL 11.11/8 rather than reclassifying its reduced stem vowel from spelling alone.
Should rkw.I.t.infectum.2 (untranslated Ilyas mental-maturity example) remain in sense 2, or align with the mental Preterit under sense 1?
Confirm whether the repeated foundation formula refers to birth, family origin or existence more generally; the proposed idiom keeps the broad beginning meaning.
Is the b-preserving composition family an independent learned rkb borrowing, or II under rkw? The proposed II section is explicitly provisional.
Confirm ko-Preterit k-rakiwo at Jan 2.23/4243 versus a contracted participial predicate, and Preterit-wa rakəwwo at Jan 1.2/32.
Is səryoyo rakiwo a productive verbal predicate or a lexical adjective, and does darbo rakiwo mean suitable rather than specifically easy?
Does korəkwo ġalabe b ṭimo denote an increase in price or a high price level?
Segment the extra -le of markawlele (Jan 3.13/124; 3.15/175).
Please provide human translations for publication; Jan English here is supplied project machine translation.
Civilization as established abstract structure; no independent establish sense required.
Heart as subject and personal ʕam-complement extend fitting/compatibility beyond clothing.
Repeated schools, institutions, relations, culture, customs, a future and installed people support the round-1 abstract establishment extension.
Parties, churches, understanding and a board are in position or constituted; collective cohesion is not split into another sense.
